shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"usage|afterModelResponse\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec:\" src scripts | head -80 && rg --files scripts/spec-links package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface UsageMetadata|type UsageMetadata\" src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/types/ai.ts && rg -n \"repoint-spec|prettier\" package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/turnUsage.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/turnUsage.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): cover missing round usage" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && if [ "$(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD')\" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --count '@{upstream}..HEAD'"
